reasons.action: No visual reference is supplied, so nothing is reference-governed. The brief also explicitly requests performed behavior — the knight riding the dragon low over the battlefield and delivering the line "Hold the line!" — so the action is settled by the request.
reasons.medium: No supplied visual reference has authority over rendering, so the medium is request-governed; only the compatible treatment 'cinematic' was accepted by the medium decision, with no named rendering process.
reasons.wardrobe: With no reference images, there is no observed clothing to retain. The request explicitly specifies battered plate armour for the knight, so wardrobe is request-governed.
reasons.lighting: No reference supplies a lighting setup, so lighting is request-governed. The requested burning battlefield describes a fire-lit scene whose illumination comes from the request.
reasons.framing: No reference frame exists to anchor composition. The request describes the scene and its cinematic intent but names no shot scale or viewpoint, so with no reference available the framing falls to the request.
reasons.palette: No reference grade or color scheme is supplied, so palette is request-governed. The 'cinematic' treatment accepted by the medium decision is the only tonal guidance in play.
